_about: claude-memwatch sentinel thresholds (hooks/tools/memwatch.py). The MemAvailable lines are percent of MemTotal (F7, 2026-10-30): warn 15, crit 8, kill_policy.emergency 4, and the swap rule's line 22.5 (1.5 x warn), so a 16 GB box warns under ~2.3 GB free and a 30 GB box under ~4.5 GB. An MB number written here pins its line (absolute); memwatch.py holds MB fallbacks for an unknown MemTotal. Tiers enter on these lines, exit with hysteresis.margin_mb and after hysteresis.holdoff_s. kill_policy stages: 1 stop own claude-index-* scopes; 2 kill the biggest browser renderer / stray build outside every claude tree; 3 stop the most idle ledger session (auto-restored). User overrides: ~/.claude/oomguard.local.json (kill_policy.enabled, protected_extra, victims_extra, shed_mode, restore_enabled, memory_high, linger, tiers); a local tiers.warn/tiers.crit number is absolute MB and wins.
